name: Sarah Pitcher-Campbell
story: Sarah Pitcher-Campbell worked across forestry GIS, remote sensing and emergency support. Interpine records her presenting cloud services linking GeoMaster, ArcGIS and Office 365 in 2013, leading remote-sensing work involving LiDAR and UAVs, and later providing GIS support to Australian wildfire incident-management teams. She subsequently moved into Eagle Technology’s GIS business.
